items.title: Green Christmas Elf Costume
items.alt: Separate green elf cap and belted tunic arranged with striped stockings and red curled shoes, without a person.
items.description: A gold star hangs from the pointed cap above the empty costume. Cream cuffs, a gold buckle and bell-tipped curled shoes make the individual clothing pieces easy to recognize.

items.title: Green Elf Mailbox
items.alt: Green Christmas mailbox with red trim, a gold bell, the words ELF MAIL and two envelopes on a small shelf.
items.description: A red flag stands above the rounded mailbox, topped by a bow and holly. Gold lettering and a snowflake decorate its sides above a complete red-and-green pedestal.

items.title: Elf Beside a Workshop Door
items.alt: Blond cartoon elf in a green dress gesturing toward a small green door with an ELF WORKSHOP sign.
items.description: The elf presents a rounded toy-sized door with red hinges, a gold handle and a tiny red hat decoration. Gold-edged dress panels and red curled shoes frame the cheerful guide beside it.

items.title: Happy Holidays Lettering with an Elf
items.alt: Red, green and gold HAPPY HOLIDAYS lettering with snowy tops, holly and a small green-clothed elf seated on the final letter.
items.description: Patterns, snow caps and a string of tiny lights decorate the two-line greeting. A curly-haired elf rests both hands under the chin above the last red letter.

items.title: Plate of Two Christmas Elf Cookies
items.alt: Cream plate holding two different elf-shaped iced cookies in green outfits, with small star cookies around them.
items.description: One cookie has white hair and a star-tipped hat; the other has dark braids and a red-banded cap. Green icing, curled shoes and holly decorations bring the festive plate together.

items.title: Green Christmas Elf Bell Ornament
items.alt: Smiling elf-shaped Christmas ornament with a gold hanging loop, green dress, silver hair buns and a handbell.
items.description: A red pom-pom and cream-edged green skirt frame the ornament's silver curls. The small gold bell and bright red curled shoes balance its outstretched arms.
